instructions: browser-manager runs several signed-in browsers for one owner behind Cloudflare Access. Report a defect only with its concrete failure: who gains access to a browser, a profile or the CDP bridge; which request is accepted that should be refused; which test or build breaks. Security boundaries: only a verified Access JWT for the configured audience and owner reaches the dashboard and viewers; the CLI and CDP bridge are reachable only through the owner-only Unix socket and loopback; nothing listens beyond 127.0.0.1.
